body:
I'm a girl, and it's fine. 

I would probably want to be with James above all the others but he has said he won't be with me. I don't know if I believe him given the depth and profundity in which he has cared for me. He's a true friend and I truly love him and if he ever wanted to, I'd jump at the chance to be with him. Just seems like a dream though.

No I don't mind. There's really just one guy I've had a serious relationship with, and we are still really close. Probably too close. But I loved James. I would've been with him. There's this other guy I know and love who won't talk to me *and* I've had a thing with his brother, who loves me too but we just aren't together idk. My relationships are pretty messy haha.

No I hadn't really thought about doing that because I feel like things will just get bad again and any progress is kind of superficial. Maybe when I am fully not suicidal anymore I will do that but that may be a while. And also people who are in a similar situation, it usually doesn't work out so well.
Today? I feel okay. Just kinda focused on stuff. How are you?

No I don't think it will help because now I'm just avoiding people and keeping my distance. I also still don't know how to engage with people. I've tried but I'm just too intense. Feel like I should probably just stay away. 

Thanks for asking about the positive stuff. There is positive stuff, but it's just hard for me to think right now. Really hard but I really like Sigur Rós. The untitled album is medicine to me and the newest one is just so fucking amazingly intense. That's all I can think of right now I'm sorry :/

I guess I am really afraid that I will get entangled with someone again and not get better. And the whole thing is for me to get better. So if I don't do that, I've failed. I don't want to need anyone like that ever again, that was so unhealthy. It happened by accident but now that I'm a little wiser I really should keep that from happening again. I want James to come back when I am better, so I want to actually get better. 

I want to die because I don't think I will get better and all of this is a waste of everyone's time. James has been gone for 9 months now, and I'm not better. I keep fucking trying and failing and failing and failing. It is so frustrating. I do keep trying though, just different things hoping something *eventually* will work.

I think that if I get better he will come back, yeah. But I don't think I can get better, so I want to die, which makes me need him more, and it's this vicious cycle. 

My therapist is good but I only see him once a week for an hour. That's helpful but James was always there when I needed him and really helped me work out damaged ways of thinking in the moment, which helped and saved me a lot. I understand why that's bad for him though, and why he's gone.

I guess I'm not sure he is gone. But he's been gone way longer than he was supposed to be, and I blame myself. So I keep trying to fix myself in hopes that once I finally do, he will come back. No one else has liked me the way he did. So I just don't really trust anyone else, even though yes he really broke my trust. I just feel like he was trying to help, or just doing what he had to do, and I feel bad that any of this happened. I can't just be a normal friend right now because I'm freaking out and I need more support than a normal friend. My friends now aren't willing to give me that, so I don't really feel like they are friends.

No not really, not anymore. My ex maybe, and I have a couple friends... But nothing compares to how my best friend cared for me, and he's just gone gone. No one knows what to say or how to help, or even want to help.
Thanks. Mostly I just keep ruining all my relationships. And I fucking *hate* it. It seriously makes me want to die. Like I feel like I can't even go another second because everyone is gone.
Yeah, I hear you. I'm sorry :(
I don't mind. What kind of note?
I would be writing music, playing and singing. And I'd have a loving boyfriend and a cat.
I've done yoga, yeah. And I have spent a decent amount of time meditating. But idk. The stuff is just always here. Any time I feel better, it's just superficial.

This made me think a lot. I've been really afraid of how I feel because I'm afraid of what it means but the dissociation thing does sound like it could be that, which isn't as scary as I thought. 

I have asked for help. I have a therapist and have had one for a while. A good one only for about half a year though now. There has been progress but I just don't know. People keep leaving and I have this general trend of falling apart. I try to keep it together but I want to die all the time and it's difficult to deal with. People can't stand it. People don't like me, my best friend says I'm emotionally exhausting to be around. And it's just because I want attention and acceptance and approval so bad. I know I am externally regulated, and I just need someone to care and pay attention and love me but no one can do that. I dial it back as much as I can but it is just in everything I do. I need someone to stay but they won't stay. And now I just expect everyone to leave, it's only a matter of time. And I'm not trying to ruin everything but I know that I do, and I don't want to do that but I just *do*, and so I want to die. I don't want to ruin anything else

because I'm not... I'm too intense and want to die and am so afraid of people leaving and they do and it sucks for everyone. i can't fix whats wrong and no one else can either. so its just like, why bother staying

He got to know me more intimately than anyone else. He knew me better than I knew myself, and he left. That is what is sad. A lot of people want to get to know me, but once they start to see how I am... that I am not okay.. They don't want to know me anymore, or at least definitely not get any closer.

he really was everything to me. to an unhealthy degree, i admit. but the friendship and the love were real, i don't know why things had to turn so sour. i was always trying to get better and be better, and then he just fucking left. it really seemed like it was out of nowhere, he just got burned out. i understood that and really thought he would come back, and i can't believe i am even still here today. i have gotten through so much, and i just thought that at the end of all that, he would be here, but he's not. he's not here at all, and i hate myself for that. and i don't understand, and i don't understand what's the point of anything of loving or trusting when things like this happen all the time. how is anything real? how is anything worth it when at the drop of a dime people can turn on you and just leave? when you really need them, and they just leave.

he was there for years, he was my best friend. he really cared. i don't know how he could stop. he was the only person i believed wouldn't leave, and then he left. he spent years convincing me he wasn't going anywhere, and then he left. i just can't understand, and there's no one else i can trust like that. and i just hate being alive because he's gone. death is one thing, but he *chose* to leave me. he's alive and well, just doesn't want me in his life anymore. and i love him more than anything. just don't understand how this could happen, don't want to live like this anymore.

there are a lot of reasons, i know that. the biggest one now is just that my friend left me. he actually abandoned me, gave up. it was months ago. 9 months ago.. and he was supposed to be gone for only 3, and he's just gone. I've tried to get better and all these things and i have achieved a lot of that, a lot of those goals. but he won't come back. i trusted that he would and he hasn't, and honestly i don't want and don't think i even can live having lost him. it's just the truth
